sarah: Quick chase on INC-438 postmortem action items, looks like a few slipped past their deadlines. Owners: @ajay (AJ-12), @mike (MK-07), @emily (EM-05). Please post a one-line status by EOD.

ajay: AJ-12  working on router retry/backoff. PR open but flaky integration test. ETA tomorrow morning. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/router/pull/149

mike: MK-07  Im blocked waiting on exporter dimension (INF-684). Eng-infra told me they'd add it by end of day tomorrow. If that slips I'll push a temporary threshold and note it in the tracker.

emily: EM-05  done and staged. Alert includes sample trace payload. Commit: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/commit/9c8d4f1

oncall-bot: AUTO: INC-438 remediation overdue reminder sent to ajay, mike, emily.

sarah: Thanks. If any owner expects >48h delay please say so now so we can reassign. Weve had repeated drift across remediations recently.

lei: If AJ-12/MK-07 still blocked after 48h Ill temporarily reassign to prevent further slippage.

ajay: PR merged 1775024000  commit d1a2b3c, fixes backoff and adds unit test: https://git.internal/r/redwood/router/commit/d1a2b3c

mike: eng-infra delivered the dimension early AM. I landed a temporary threshold to reduce alert noise: https://git.internal/r/redwood/ops/commit/6b7c1d0. Will replace with final rule in MK-07-epic and post the link.

sarah: Great. Emily: please update the PM tracker with EM-05 status. Mike: post the final replacement commit when ready and I'll mark MK-07 remediated.

emily: Tracker updated  EM-05 marked done.

mike: Replaced temp threshold with final rule, commit: https://git.internal/r/redwood/ops/commit/8f2e4b5 (1775025600)

sarah: Verified commits/links for AJ-12, MK-07, EM-05. Marking remediation chase closed. If anything regresses reopen INC-438 or file INF-... and ping #incidents. :white_check_mark:
